metadata.description: A gated 9-phase SDLC for solo founders shipping with AI. Validates the business case before the repo exists, keeps every decision in git, and refuses to let the author grade their own work.

plugins.name: solo-sdlc
plugins.description: A gated 9-phase SDLC for a solo founder shipping with AI: idea → validate → spec → architecture → plan → execute → QA → release → retro. Ships three skills (idea finder, pipeline, browser evidence), six adversarial review agents, and a machine gate: check-gate exit 0, not a sign-off.
